installAgentPrompt: E hoʻonohonoho iā HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) ma kēia kamepiula. E hoʻokomo i ka HAX CLI me `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`, a laila e hoʻokomo i kona mau mākau ʻelele me `hax skills install --all`. E hana i kahua me `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`, e hoʻomaka iā ia me `cd my-hax-site && hax serve`, a e haʻi mai iaʻu i ka helu wahi āna e paʻi ai. E heluhelu i ka AGENTS.md o ke kahua a me https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw ma mua o kou hoʻololi ʻana i kekahi mea.
